title: Thingiverse - Support de telephone communautaire pour Porsche 993/964
notes: La page Thingiverse est indexee sous le titre Phone Mount for Porsche 993 and 964. L'archive Renn 3D Parts en expose une copie de fichier STL, declaree CC-BY, avec un anneau prevu autour d'un compteur de 82 mm et une bbox de 136,013 x 91,999 x 35,520 mm. Cette confirmation vient d'une archive secondaire; la page primaire et les unites ne sont pas relues ici, et la licence primaire doit etre verifiee avant redistribution. Piste de CAO amateur a comparer sur un interieur 993; aucune declaration d'ajustement ou de precision ne doit etre promue. 2026-10-15: same asset as SRC-RENN3D-GAUGE-RING-PHONE-MOUNT, whose secondary archive declares CC-BY without a version; the licence string here now records that declaration. On 2026-10-15 the original Thingiverse page (thing 3143518) was not read: www.thingiverse.com served its robots.txt behind a Cloudflare bot challenge (HTTP 403, 'Just a moment...') to both the page-reading tool and a plain HTTP client, so permission for automated agents could not be established and the thing page was not requested. The Internet Archive index holds only redirects of the thing's ZIP download, not a capture of the page. The 2026-08-29 'available' status could not be reproduced. Rights remain unknown in both records. 2026-11-07: the live primary Thingiverse page was read in an ordinary browser without login or challenge bypass; the explicit Creative Commons link confirms CC-BY-4.0. See docs/research/thingiverse-primary-licences-20261107.md for the exact asset, author, file list and limits. This supersedes the earlier access/licence conclusion, while preserving the historical notes. No model file was downloaded or imported; dimensions, units and fitment remain independently unverified. Secondary-page access dates are unchanged because those pages were not reread.
